text: **Gum trees (eucalyptus)** are by far the most common type of tree in Australia. Their bark is typically light-coloured, with puffy puffy clusters of leaves.
NOTE: Their look may vary significantly, depending on your location within the country. More details can be found in the region-guessing section.
text_zh: **桉樹（尤加利樹）**是澳洲最常見的樹種。它們的樹皮通常顏色較淺，葉子呈蓬鬆的簇狀。
注意：它們的外觀可能會有很大的差異，取決於你在該國境內的位置。更多細節請參閱區域判斷章節。

text: Australian bollards are white, with a **red reflector** on the front, and a grey reflector on the back.
NOTE: New Zealand uses a bollard where the red reflector wraps around the back, meaning the reflector goes from end to end while the Australian one stops in the middle.
text_zh: 澳洲的路樁是白色的，正面有**紅色反光片**，背面有灰色反光片。
注意：紐西蘭的路樁，其紅色反光片會環繞到背面，這表示反光片是從頭到尾延伸的，而澳洲的路樁則是在中間就停止了。

text: Australia drives on the **left**.
NOTE: A handful of other countries also drive on the left. See [this](/images/australia/rightleftdrive.png) infographic for more information.
text_zh: 澳洲是**靠左**行駛的。
注意：少數其他國家也是靠左行駛。更多資訊請參閱[這張](/images/australia/rightleftdrive.png)資訊圖表。

text: Australia uses almost exclusively **white road lines**, with a few rare exceptions in alpine regions such as Mount Kosciuszko and Mount Hotham.

NOTE: If you are considering guessing in Australia, but see yellow outside lines or a yellow middle line, you will probably be in South Africa or New Zealand respectively. Note that New Zealand can have all white road lines as well.
text_zh: 澳洲幾乎只使用**白色道路標線**，只有少數例外是在高山地區，例如 Mount Kosciuszko 和 Mount Hotham。
注意：如果你考慮猜澳洲，但看到黃色的外側標線或黃色的中央標線，你很可能分別是在南非或紐西蘭。請注意，紐西蘭也可能全部都是白色道路標線。

text: Outside lines in Australia sometimes feature **rumble strips** that look like small white stripes perpendicular to the road line.
NOTE: Northern Territory roads very rarely have rumble strips.
In addition, you can find similar rumble strips in New Zealand.
text_zh: 澳洲的外側標線有時會出現**減速標線**，這些標線看起來像與道路標線垂直的小白條。
注意：北領地的道路非常少見減速標線。
此外，你也可以在紐西蘭找到類似的減速標線。

text: **Give-way signs** in Australia have a white border and black text.
NOTE: New Zealand’s give-way signs use red, instead of black, text. Give-way signs are very rarely seen in South Africa.
text_zh: 澳洲的**讓路標誌**有白色邊框和黑色文字。
注意：紐西蘭的讓路標誌使用紅色文字，而非黑色。南非則非常罕見讓路標誌。

text: Australia uses **white on black** and **black on yellow** chevrons.
text_zh: 澳洲使用**白底黑字**和**黃底黑字**的轉彎標誌。

text: **Green **signs with white arrows on either side can be seen at intersections which show nearby towns or cities. A number indicating the number of **kilometres **away the town can sometimes be seen.
text_zh: 在路口可見**綠色**標誌，兩側有白色箭頭，顯示附近的城鎮。有時可見標示城鎮距離的**公里數**。

text: Australian speed limit signs have black text in a red circle on a large white **rectangle**.
NOTE: New Zealand speed limit signs normally do not have the white rectangular background.
text_zh: 澳洲的速限標誌為黑色文字，位於紅色圓圈內，並置於大型白色**矩形**背景上。
注意：紐西蘭的速限標誌通常沒有白色矩形背景。

text: A **long** antenna can be seen in Generation 3 coverage.
text_zh: 在第三代街景覆蓋中可見一根**長**天線。

text: Different states use **different **licence plate designs, which can be somewhat visible through the blur.
text_zh: 各州使用**不同**的車牌設計，這些設計在模糊中仍可略微辨識。

text: Australian phone numbers are 8 digits with a 2-digit area code in front. A map of these by state can be seen here. Keep in mind, **not all** phone numbers will include an area code in front of it.
text_zh: 澳洲的電話號碼為 8 位數，前面有 2 位數的區碼。各州的區碼地圖可在此處查看。請記住，**並非所有**電話號碼都會在前面包含區碼。

text: Each state has a **unique **bus stop design. These are quite common in urban rounds, so are worth learning. Darwin bus stops are usually [concrete shelters](https://goo.gl/maps/UR1Qq4BcyJGkCZ9n8).
NOTE: The designs may vary slightly, but should still be recognisable. There are multiple versions of Tasmanian bus stops, but most of them should have the word ‘metro’ on it.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 每個州都有**獨特**的公車站設計。這些在城市回合中很常見，值得學習。達爾文的公車站通常是[水泥候車亭](https://goo.gl/maps/UR1Qq4BcyJGkCZ9n8)。
注意：設計可能略有不同，但仍應能辨識。塔斯馬尼亞的公車站有多種版本，但大多數都應該有「metro」這個詞。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The area around Warramboo in SA to Madura in WA has a unique landscape. Vegetation is quite **dry **and is made up of shrubs and **wide crowned eucalyptus**. In addition, the soil is sandy with a slight orange tint.
The dry area east of Adelaide and into northwestern Victoria has a similar landscape, with the same vegetation but usually with [**whiter soil**](https://goo.gl/maps/rFiSFVLVUJcF4kGt5).
NOTE: The soil gets more red in the WA side. Redder soil can also be seen more inland on the Victorian side around Mildura. In addition, the Nullarbor Highway has a distinct landscape.
text_zh: 從南澳（SA）的 Warramboo 到西澳（WA）的 Madura 一帶有獨特的景觀。植被相當**乾燥**，由灌木叢和**寬冠桉樹**組成。此外，土壤是沙質的，帶有淡淡的橘色。
阿得雷德以東和維多利亞西北部的乾燥地區有相似的景觀，植被相同，但土壤通常[**更白**](https://goo.gl/maps/rFiSFVLVUJcF4kGt5)。
注意：在西澳（WA）一側，土壤會更紅。在維多利亞（Victorian）一側，米爾杜拉（Mildura）周圍的內陸地區也能看到更紅的土壤。此外，納拉伯公路（Nullarbor Highway）有獨特的景觀。

text: **Lush green or golden **fields can be found in this band from the south of the Yorke Peninsula to Echuca. In the SA side, the landscape should be drier than the Victorian side and more wide crowned eucalyptus can be seen. On the Victorian side, the trees generally have more leaves and are taller.
NOTE: The area near Mount Gambier has a distinct landscape. For more information, see below.
text_zh: 從約克半島（Yorke Peninsula）南部到埃丘卡（Echuca）的這條地帶，可以發現**鬱鬱蔥蔥的綠色或金黃色**田野。在南澳（SA）一側，景觀應該比維多利亞（Victorian）一側更乾燥，可以看到更多寬冠桉樹。在維多利亞（Victorian）一側，樹木通常葉子更多且更高。
注意：甘比爾山（Mount Gambier）附近的地區有獨特的景觀。欲了解更多資訊，請參閱下方。

text: Coastal northern Queensland is very **tropical**. Typical vegetation consists of palm trees and dark green vegetation.
text_zh: 昆士蘭（Queensland）北部沿海地區非常**熱帶**。典型的植被由棕櫚樹和深綠色植物組成。

text: The landscape in inland NSW is mostly flat, and the soil gets **redder **the more inland you go. Vegetation consists of mostly dry **pale-green shrubs**. Further east and on the Queensland and Victorian borders, the climate gets more temperate but is still quite dry and more eucalyptus trees can be seen, with the soil transitioning into a more sandy colour as well as more hills being [visible](https://goo.gl/maps/GhZAimbF6eymrGVE9).
text_zh: 新南威爾斯（NSW）內陸地區的景觀大多平坦，越往內陸，土壤就越**紅**。植被主要由乾燥的**淺綠色灌木叢**組成。再往東，在昆士蘭（Queensland）和維多利亞（Victorian）邊界，氣候變得更溫和，但仍然相當乾燥，可以看到更多的桉樹，土壤也過渡到更沙質的顏色，並且可以看到更多的[山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/GhZAimbF6eymrGVE9)。

text: The vegetation in the area surrounding **Darwin** is extremely distinct. It features dark red soil, as well as rich green grass and trees. The tree trunks are typically black.
text_zh: **達爾文**周圍地區的植被非常獨特。它以深紅色土壤、茂盛的綠草和樹木為特色。樹幹通常是黑色的。

text: Tasmania has a **cool temperate** climate which is uncommon in the rest of Australia and is comparable to central-southern Chile or New Zealand. Typical landscape consists of green rolling hills that can look dry in winter coverage. Eucalyptus trees can be seen on the side of roads and on hills in the distance. Rural Tasmania is also quite hilly with dense eucalyptus forests making up the [landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/zcCanmsdVyGkoXY49).
NOTE: Certain areas of Victoria can look similar so make sure to look for other clues.
text_zh: 塔斯馬尼亞擁有澳洲其他地區少見的**涼爽溫帶**氣候，與智利中南部或紐西蘭相當。典型的景觀包含綠色起伏的丘陵，在冬季街景覆蓋中看起來可能較為乾燥。路邊和遠處的山丘上可以看到桉樹。塔斯馬尼亞的鄉村地區丘陵起伏，濃密的桉樹林構成了這裡的[景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/zcCanmsdVyGkoXY49)。
備註：維多利亞州的部分地區看起來可能很相似，因此務必尋找其他線索。

text: **Termite mounds** can sometimes be seen in the Northern Territory and rarely northern WA and QLD. They appear as brown, spiky formations rising out of the ground.
text_zh: 在北領地有時可以看到**白蟻丘**，西澳州和昆士蘭州北部則較為罕見。它們呈現為從地面升起的棕色尖銳結構。

text: These **brush plants** are commonly seen in Western Australia.
text_zh: 這些**灌木植物**常見於西澳州。

text: **Sugarcane plantations** are very common in Northern Queensland, due to its tropical climate.

NOTE: Sugarcane plantations can be seen as far south as northern NSW, however are most commonly found in northern Queensland. For a detailed overview, see [this](/images/australia/australia_sugarcane.png) map.
text_zh: 由於熱帶氣候的緣故，**甘蔗園**在北昆士蘭州非常常見。
備註：甘蔗園最南可以在新南威爾斯州北部看到，但最常見於北昆士蘭州。詳細總覽請參閱[這張](/images/australia/australia_sugarcane.png)地圖。

text: The iconic **Stobie pole**, made of steel and concrete, is specific to South Australia. The [pole tops](https://goo.gl/maps/Le5eiGxw9bRT1UQJA) (trident or rotated letter “E”) are also unique.
NOTE: A few thousand of these poles can be found in other states, most notably Tasmania.
text_zh: 由鋼材與混凝土製成的標誌性 **Stobie 電線桿**是南澳州特有的。其[電線桿頂部](https://goo.gl/maps/Le5eiGxw9bRT1UQJA)（三叉戟狀或旋轉的字母「E」）也是獨一無二的。
備註：在其他州也可以找到數千根這種電線桿，最明顯的是塔斯馬尼亞。

text: These **rusty metal poles**, containing several holes, are unique to the Northern Territory.
NOTE: These poles can also sometimes be found in some areas of northern WA, such as Wyndham.
text_zh: 這些帶有數個孔洞的**生鏽金屬電線桿**是北領地特有的。
備註：這些電線桿有時也會出現在西澳州北部的某些地區，例如溫德姆（Wyndham）。

text: According to a [2006 review](https://era.daf.qld.gov.au/id/eprint/3071/2/dpiandena_timber_pole_review06-sec.pdf#page=37), 64% of all **concrete poles** are located in the state of Victoria.
text_zh: 根據一份 [2006 年的文獻](https://era.daf.qld.gov.au/id/eprint/3071/2/dpiandena_timber_pole_review06-sec.pdf#page=37)，所有**水泥電線桿**中有 64% 位於維多利亞州。

text: A **trident-like** pole top can sometimes be seen in Western Australia and Victoria. In Western Australia, the pole will often have red insulators and black paint on the crossbar (shown in the image).

For the meta to work, all 3 insulators must be connected to the crossbar. This [link ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LLZCJkuNYMoqU13m6)shows a similar looking pole that is incorrect, as the middle insulator is connected to the pole itself rather than to the crossbar.
text_zh: 在西澳州與維多利亞州，有時可以看到**三叉戟狀**的電線桿頂部。在西澳州，電線桿的橫樑上通常會有紅色絕緣子和黑色塗漆（如圖所示）。
要讓這個線索特徵成立，所有 3 個絕緣子都必須連接到橫樑上。這個[連結 ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LLZCJkuNYMoqU13m6)顯示了一根看起來相似但不符合條件的電線桿，因為中間的絕緣子是連接到電線桿本身而非橫樑。

text: Queensland features these unique pole tops with coils that are **angled upwards** on the sides.
text_zh: 昆士蘭州的特色是擁有這種獨特的電線桿頂部，兩側的線圈**向上傾斜**。

text: Victorian pole tops feature 3 circular coils; 2 on the sides, and 1 vertical one at the top. At times, other [extensions](https://goo.gl/maps/p8m8EP5gHfnEgxyV7) can be seen on these poles.
text_zh: 維多利亞州的電線桿頂部有 3 個圓形線圈：兩側各 1 個，頂部有 1 個垂直的。有時在這些電線桿上可以看到其他的[延伸結構](https://goo.gl/maps/p8m8EP5gHfnEgxyV7)。

text: Poletops in Tasmania often consist of a **thin metal crossbar** **bent 90 degrees** to form an **L-shape.**
NOTE: Regular Australian crossbars are usually made out of [wood](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d3nvo8eN8rPtWV9B9).
text_zh: 塔斯馬尼亞的電線桿頂部通常由**細金屬橫樑****彎曲 90 度**組成，呈現 **L 形。**
備註：澳洲一般的橫樑通常是由[木頭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d3nvo8eN8rPtWV9B9)製成的。

text: Circular **blue** stickers can be found on Queensland poles. You may occasionally see the same type of sticker in a [different colour](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UsntugJachBVdzvp6), or with the colour almost [completely faded](https://goo.gl/maps/buTdGYBCeYaShRgs5).
NOTE: Blue stickers can also be found on French poles.
text_zh: 昆士蘭州的電線桿上可以看到圓形的**藍色**貼紙。偶爾你可能會看到[不同顏色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UsntugJachBVdzvp6)的同款貼紙，或是顏色幾乎[完全褪色](https://goo.gl/maps/buTdGYBCeYaShRgs5)的貼紙。
備註：法國的電線桿上也可以找到藍色貼紙。

text: These **black markings** are specific to electricity poles in the region encompassing the cities of Gold Coast, Brisbane, and Sunshine Coast in Queensland. They are often accompanied by diagonal numbers.
text_zh: 這些**黑色標記**是昆士蘭州包含黃金海岸、布里斯本和陽光海岸等城市區域的電線桿特有的。它們通常伴隨著斜向排列的數字。

text: **Olive-green possum guards** are only found on electricity poles in Tasmania.
NOTE: Possum guards are found all over Australia. The colour is what distinguishes them.
text_zh: **橄欖綠色的負鼠防護罩**僅見於塔斯馬尼亞的電線桿上。
備註：防負鼠罩全澳洲都有，顏色才是區分它們的關鍵。

text: Poles in Western Australia often have **green **painted bases, and sometimes a white sticker or a [red and white](https://goo.gl/maps/3G4CJepKWTr6Zw1e7) band attached.
text_zh: 西澳州的電線桿基座通常漆成**綠色 **，有時還會貼有白色貼紙或[紅白相間](https://goo.gl/maps/3G4CJepKWTr6Zw1e7)的條帶。

text: Reflectors that are **shorter **in height than the regular ones are most common in Queensland and South Australia.
NOTE: This is most consistent with 4 or more short reflectors visible in the round. A low amount of short reflectors is less consistent. This is not consistent in Generation 2.
text_zh: 高度比一般反射器**較短 **的反射器最常見於昆士蘭州與南澳州。
備註：當全景中能看到 4 個或更多短反射器時最為可靠。少量的短反射器可靠度較低。這在 Generation 2 相機世代中並不一致。

text: Bollards with **brown paint** at the bottom are most commonly found in Western Australia.
NOTE: Brown paint at the bottom of [exposed bollards](https://goo.gl/maps/KuQaRmJgbJ6kBUda7) can also rarely be seen in other states, however the brown section will not be as large.
text_zh: 底部塗有**棕色漆**的路樁最常見於西澳州。
備註：[露出地面的路樁](https://goo.gl/maps/KuQaRmJgbJ6kBUda7)底部有棕色漆的情況在其他州偶爾也能看到，但棕色部分的範圍不會那麼大。

text: These black-and-white **stripy **bollards are unique to Western Australia.
text_zh: 這種黑白**條紋 **路樁是西澳州特有的。

text: This **black-and-yellow** bollard is exclusive to Queensland.
text_zh: 這種**黃黑相間**路樁是昆士蘭州獨有的。

text: **Yellow signposts** are specific to Western Australia.
NOTE: Although South Australia does not use yellow signposts for regular road signs, SA bus stops will have yellow posts.
text_zh: **黃色標誌桿**是西澳州特有的。
備註：雖然南澳州的一般道路標誌不使用黃色標誌桿，但南澳州的公車站牌會使用黃色桿子。

text: Some signposts in South Australia and Western Australia are **flat **rather than round.
NOTE: These signposts are usually yellow in Western Australia.
text_zh: 南澳州與西澳州的部分標誌桿是**扁平的 **，而不是圓形的。
備註：這些標誌桿在西澳州通常是黃色的。

text: Signposts in the Northern Territory can feature these **yellow **stickers.
text_zh: 北領地的標誌桿上可能會有這些**黃色 **貼紙。

text: Road signs with a **fluorescent border** are almost exclusively found in Queensland.
text_zh: 帶有**螢光邊框**的道路標誌幾乎只出現在昆士蘭州。

text: New South Wales is the only state to use **red ‘No Stopping’ signs**.
NOTE: All other states use white versions.
text_zh: 新南威爾斯州是唯一使用**紅色的 ‘No Stopping’ 標誌**的州。
備註：其他所有的州都使用白色版本。

text: The white ‘No Stopping’ and ‘No Parking’ signs that** include text** are unique to the Australian Capital Territory.
text_zh: **包含文字 **的白色 ‘No Stopping’ 與 ‘No Parking’ 標誌是澳洲首都領地特有的。

text: **White **directional signs can only be found in Tasmania.
text_zh: **白色 **的方向指示標誌僅見於塔斯馬尼亞。

text: Roads that start with the letter **‘C’ **are only found in Victoria and Tasmania. In addition, South Australia has some C roads near the border with Victoria.
NOTE: Since these are smaller and less major roads, Generation 1 or 2 is common.
text_zh: 以字母 **‘C’ **開頭的公路僅見於維多利亞州與塔斯馬尼亞。此外，南澳州在與維多利亞州接壤的邊境附近也有一些 C 級公路。
備註：由於這些是較小且非主要的道路，因此常見 Generation 1 或 2 相機世代。

text: Within Australia, a speed limit of **130 km/h** can only be found in the Northern Territory.
text_zh: 在澳洲境內，**130 km/h** 的速限僅見於北領地。

text: Some ‘Keep Left’ signs in New South Wales, Queensland, and the Northern Territory use this thinner version, which does **not **include an arrow.
text_zh: 新南威爾斯州、昆士蘭州和北領地的部分 ‘Keep Left’ 標誌使用這種較薄的版本，其中**不 **包含箭頭。

text: Traffic lights with a **white outline** around the frame are found in the eastern and western states of WA, QLD, NSW, ACT and Tas. Traffic lights without a border are found in the remaining, central states.
text_zh: 外框帶有**白色輪廓**的紅綠燈見於東部與西部的州：WA、QLD、NSW、ACT 和 Tas。不帶邊框的紅綠燈則見於其餘的中部各州。

text: You can find these **dark green** property markers on the sides of roads in Western Australia.
text_zh: 你可以在西澳州的路邊看到這些**深綠色**的地界標記。

text: You can find these **white **property markers on the sides of roads in South Australia.
text_zh: 你可以在南澳州的路邊看到這些**白色 **的地界標記。

text: This **guardrail ending**, featuring a black dash on a yellow background, is almost exclusive to New South Wales and the ACT.
text_zh: 這種黃底黑短線的**護欄末端**幾乎僅見於新南威爾斯州與澳洲首都領地。

text: You can find these white hydrant poles that feature a** blue circle** and a red section on top of it in Victoria.
text_zh: 你可以在維多利亞州看到這些帶有**藍色圓形**且頂部為紅色的白色消防栓桿。

text: These fire hydrants with **red painted tops** are unique to Victoria.
text_zh: 這些**頂部漆成紅色**的消防栓是維多利亞州特有的。

text: **Generation 2** **cannot** be found in the Northern Territory.
text_zh: **Generation 2 相機世代****無法**在北領地找到。

text: Australia is home to dozens of **rare Google cars**, which can usually be found in natural reserves.

Most rare Google cars with **snorkels **are located in New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. The [snorkels](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_snorkel) are dark grey or black extensions to the side of the car, to keep the engine dry when submerged in water.
NOTE: The only snorkels outside NSW and ACT are found on two cars in Western Australia ([1](https://goo.gl/maps/wFgk2iGZBaQLe2nN8) and [2](https://goo.gl/maps/Em5BHeArvFHzkiJ29)).
_GeoHints has a complete overview of all rare cars, which can be found on [this page](https://geohints.com/meta/googleVehicles/cars)._
text_zh: 澳洲擁有數十輛**稀有 Google 車**，通常可以在自然保護區找到。
大多數裝有**涉水管 **的稀有 Google 車都位於新南威爾斯州和澳洲首都領地。[涉水管](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_snorkel)是車側深灰色或黑色的延伸管，用於在車輛涉水時保持引擎乾燥。
註：新南威爾斯州和澳洲首都領地之外唯一裝有涉水管的，是西澳的兩輛車（[1](https://goo.gl/maps/wFgk2iGZBaQLe2nN8) 和 [2](https://goo.gl/maps/Em5BHeArvFHzkiJ29)）。
_GeoHints 在[這個頁面](https://geohints.com/meta/googleVehicles/cars)提供了所有稀有車輛的完整總覽。_

text: For country streak purposes, Christmas Island and Cocos (Keeling) Islands **are counted** as part of Australia. For example, clicking Australia on Christmas Island counts as a country streak.
These islands have **unique cars** which makes them easily identifiable.
_Plonk It has a more in-depth guide to Christmas Island [here](https://www.plonkit.net/christmas-island)._
_Plonk It has a more in-depth guide to Cocos (Keeling) Islands [here](https://www.plonkit.net/cocos-islands)._
text_zh: 在國家連勝模式中，聖誕島和科克斯（基林）群島**會算作**澳洲的一部分。例如，在聖誕島點擊澳洲會算入國家連勝。
這些島嶼擁有**獨特的車輛**，因此很容易辨認。
_Plonk It 在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/christmas-island)有關於聖誕島更深入的攻略。_
_Plonk It 在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/cocos-islands)有關於科克斯（基林）群島更深入的攻略。_

text: The area around Tom Price can be recognized by its **red **soil, Generation 2 camera and **rocky hills**.
text_zh: 湯姆普萊斯（Tom Price）周邊地區可以透過其**紅色的 **土壤、第 2 世代相機和**多石的山丘**來辨識。

text: Alice Springs, an isolated town in the southern part of the Northern Territory, features distinct **orange rocks** that can be seen in the distance or at the end of roads.
text_zh: 愛麗斯泉是位於北領地南部的偏遠城鎮，遠處或道路盡頭可見獨特的**橘色岩石**。

text: The northern QLD city of Cairns is distinct due to its **tropical **vegetation and big green mountains around the city.

NOTE: To differentiate Cairns from other northern Queensland towns, Cairns has many high rise buildings and should feel quite urban. [Divided roads](https://goo.gl/maps/3HjnCsgmbsdWAFMA9) are also common in downtown Cairns, and only commonly seen in Mackay further south, where it is less tropical and more flat.
text_zh: 昆士蘭北部的城市凱恩斯以其**熱帶 **植被和城市周圍綠意盎然的大山為特色。
註：若要將凱恩斯與昆士蘭北部的其他城鎮區分開來，凱恩斯有許多高樓大廈，都市感相當強。凱恩斯市中心也很常見[分隔道路](https://goo.gl/maps/3HjnCsgmbsdWAFMA9)，而這種道路只在更南邊的麥凱（Mackay）較為常見，但麥凱的熱帶感較少且地形更為平坦。

text: The **Grampians** are isolated hills that are viewable from afar within the otherwise flat western Victorian agricultural landscape.
text_zh: **格蘭坪**是一片獨立的山丘，在維多利亞州西部平坦的農業景觀中可以從遠處望見。

text: The area around **Mount Gambier**, SA features white soil and extensive pine tree plantations, making it recognisable.
text_zh: 南澳**甘比爾山**周邊地區具有白色土壤和廣闊的松樹造林地，非常容易辨識。

text: **Kangaroo Island** in South Australia tends to have a distinct look. The vegetation mostly consists of bushes and low, stubby eucalyptus trees with puffy clusters of leaves. The orange soil colour is reminiscent of Western Australia.
In addition, the island only has Generation 2, and [Generation 4](https://goo.gl/maps/hJLoayN4ogUyFonx8) coverage.
text_zh: 南澳的**袋鼠島**通常有獨特的外觀。植被主要由灌木和矮短、樹葉成簇蓬鬆的尤加利樹組成。橘色的土壤顏色讓人聯想到西澳。
此外，該島只有第 2 世代和[第 4 世代](https://goo.gl/maps/hJLoayN4ogUyFonx8)街景覆蓋。

text: The **Stirling Ranges** are a small mountain range in Western Australia that tower over a largely flat plain, such that they can be viewed from a distance.
text_zh: **斯特靈山脈**是西澳的一座小山脈，聳立在大片平坦的平原上，因此可以從遠處看見。

text: The Nullarbor Highway (Latin for “no tree”) can be easily recognized thanks to the flatness, overall grey look and **very low vegetation**.
NOTE: Use the road angle or road lines to determine whether you are on the WA or SA side.
text_zh: 納拉伯公路（Nullarbor Highway，拉丁文意為「無樹」）因地形平坦、整體呈灰色調以及**非常矮小的植被**而很容易辨認。
註：利用道路角度或道路標線來判斷你是在西澳還是南澳這一側。

text: On most of the Northern Territory section of the Barkly Highway and a small part of the Queensland section, a **wire **can be seen on the left side of the car.
text_zh: 在巴克利公路北領地的大部分路段以及昆士蘭的一小部分路段，可以在車輛左側看到一根**電線 **。

text: Dorat Road (23) in the Northern Territory can be easily recognized thanks to its distinct Darwin area landscape and **lack** of road lines.
text_zh: 北領地的 Dorat Road (23) 很容易辨認，這要歸功於其獨特的達爾文地區景觀以及**缺乏**道路標線。

text: The Sturt Highway from Wentworth to Wagga Wagga can have **triple **broken centre lines.
NOTE: Triple broken centre lines can also be found on other major roads in NSW, such as the Gwydir Highway. However, they are most common on the Sturt Highway.
text_zh: 從溫特沃斯（Wentworth）到瓦加瓦加（Wagga Wagga）的斯圖爾特公路（Sturt Highway）可能劃有**三條 **虛線中央線。
註：三條虛線中央線也可以在新南威爾斯州的其他主要道路上找到，例如葛威迪公路（Gwydir Highway）。不過，它們在斯圖爾特公路上最常見。

text: The Stuart Highway from Alice Springs to around Pimba, SA can be easily recognized by its **bright orange** dirt, short trees and blue car Generation 4.
NOTE: Use the road angle and whether there are [rumble strips](https://goo.gl/maps/71LHNi6HTXB6VwCt8) to determine whether you are in NT or SA. Rumble strips are much rarer on the NT side.
text_zh: 從愛麗斯泉到南澳潘巴（Pimba）附近的史都華公路（Stuart Highway）很容易辨認，因為這裡有**鮮橘色**泥土、矮樹和藍色車身的第 4 世代街景。
註：利用道路角度以及是否有[減速條](https://goo.gl/maps/71LHNi6HTXB6VwCt8)來判斷你在北領地還是南澳。北領地一側的減速條要少得多。

text: Melbourne poles commonly feature these white, rectangular stickers, with a smaller **blue square **inside it.
text_zh: 墨爾本的電線桿通常貼有這種白色長方形貼紙，中間有一個較小的**藍色正方形 **。

text: All-**yellow **road lines can be seen on roads around Mount Kosciuszko.
In addition, a unique white truck with a **snorkel**, and cab guard can be found.
NOTE: All yellow road lines can also be found in other alpine areas in Victoria and New South Wales, so make sure to look at the landscape and other clues.
text_zh: 科斯丘斯科山周圍的道路上可以看到全**黃色 **道路標線。
此外，還能看到一輛帶有**涉水管**和駕駛室防護欄的獨特白色卡車。
註：全黃色道路標線也可以在維多利亞州和新南威爾斯州的其他高山地區看到，因此請務必觀察景觀和其他線索。

text: South Australian style **Stobie poles** can sometimes be found in the NSW town of Broken Hill.
text_zh: 南澳風格的**斯托比電線桿**有時可以在新南威爾斯州的布羅肯希爾鎮看到。

text: This street sign is unique to **Brisbane **City Council.
text_zh: 這種路牌是**布里斯本 **市議會特有的。

text: This street sign is unique to **Gold Coast** City Council.
text_zh: 這種路牌是**黃金海岸**市議會特有的。

text: This street sign is unique to the City of **Sydney**.
text_zh: 這種路牌是**雪梨**市特有的。
